analysis.reason: 3일 연속 하락세(-4.79%, -3.45%, -2.25%)로 RSI가 33.0까지 하락하며 과매도 구간에 진입했다. MACD 히스토그램은 개선 신호를 유지하고 있으나, SMA5($544.75)와 SMA20($578.30)이 현재가($504.22) 위에 있어 단기 하락 추세가 유지되고 있다. ADX가 24.3으로 추세 형성 초기 단계이므로 관망한다.
analysis.reasonEn: Three consecutive days of decline (-4.79%, -3.45%, -2.25%) pushed RSI down to 33.0 into oversold territory. MACD histogram shows sustained improvement signals, but SMA5 ($544.75) and SMA20 ($578.30) remain above the current price ($504.22), indicating a short-term downtrend. ADX at 24.3 suggests an early stage of trend formation, warranting a wait-and-see approach.

analysis.weeklyConflictEn: Weekly RSI at 49.1 and weekly MACD histogram at -10.7604 indicate weakness, but weekly ADX at 34.7 shows a clear trend. The daily oversold entry and MACD improvement signal conflict with the weekly weakness, leading to a cautious stance.
